## ZBoard v0.0.3 Release Candidate

Changes since the [November 17 release candidate](https://github.com/zerodenet/zboard/releases/tag/v0.0.3-rc.202611170907).

- **Protocol duplication.** Node-group delivery automatically retries temporary credential lock contention. Node configuration is published after credential reconciliation succeeds.
- **Protocol configuration.** Create, edit, and copy protocols in a side panel. New protocols default to the editable IPv6 wildcard `::`. IPv4 reachability with this wildcard depends on the node's socket settings. Enter `0.0.0.0` to bind IPv4 interfaces.
- **Managed DNS.** Public DNS verification runs in the background after the first successful provider sync. Results from previous syncs are discarded.
- **Connect.** Synced configurations use the active subscription template, including saved policy groups and rule sets. ZNet Sink receives the Base64 Zero configuration.

### Upgrade and downloads

Back up the database and deployment configuration before upgrading. This candidate adds no database migrations since the previous RC. Use the exact RC tag for the `ghcr.io/zerodenet/zboard` image. The Linux amd64 binary and offline Docker image are under **Assets**. Verify both archives against `SHA256SUMS`.

## 简体中文

本版汇总 [11 月 17 日候选版](https://github.com/zerodenet/zboard/releases/tag/v0.0.3-rc.202611170907) 以来的变更。

- **复制节点协议。** 节点组交付遇到临时凭证锁冲突时会自动重试，凭证对齐后再发布节点配置。
- **协议配置。** 创建、编辑和复制协议改用侧栏。新建协议的监听地址默认为可编辑的 IPv6 通配地址 `::`。使用该地址时，IPv4 能否接入取决于节点的套接字设置。仅监听 IPv4 接口可填写 `0.0.0.0`。
- **托管 DNS。** 首次供应商同步成功后，后台自动核验公共解析，并丢弃旧同步对应的核验结果。
- **Connect。** 同步配置采用已启用的订阅模板，包含后台保存的策略组和规则集。ZNet Sink 收到 Base64 编码的 Zero 配置。

### 升级和下载

升级前请备份数据库和部署配置。相比上一候选版，本次没有新增数据库迁移。Docker 请使用 `ghcr.io/zerodenet/zboard` 的准确 RC 标签。Linux amd64 二进制包和离线 Docker 镜像见 **Assets**，请使用 `SHA256SUMS` 校验。
